ay.den0707: Arno "Smokes" Den took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Arno "Smokes" Den fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Arno "Rabbit" Calin, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
king_baldwin_irl: Zeno Irl walked into R-F21 on Day 4 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Zeno Irl and Matthias Universal divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Zeno Irl ate two helpings anyway.
